facts.fact: StackAdapt announced on May 9, 2023 that it had been selected as one of Canada's Best Managed Companies in 2023.
facts.quote: is proud to announce it has been selected as one of

facts.fact: Canada's Best Managed Companies program was launched in 1993.
facts.quote: Every year since the launch of the program in 1993, hundreds of entrepreneurial companies have competed

facts.fact: The Canada's Best Managed Companies program grants awards on four levels.
facts.quote: The awards are granted on four levels

facts.fact: A Best Managed winner that re-applies and retains its designation receives it for two additional years, subject to annual operational and financial review.
facts.quote: award recipients that have re-applied and successfully retained their Best Managed designation for two additional years

facts.fact: Gold Standard winners, after three consecutive years of maintaining Best Managed status, retain their award for 4-6 consecutive years.
facts.quote: successfully retained their award for 4-6 consecutive years

facts.fact: Platinum Club membership requires maintaining Best Managed status for seven years or more.
facts.quote: winners that have maintained their Best Managed status for seven years or more
